_comment: Pipeline dependency graph — used by tools/assembly/invalidate.py to compute stale-artifact sets after a diff. Each rule maps a source-file pattern to derived-artifact patterns + the regen command. Pattern variables: {slug} (episode slug — extracted from source path), * (wildcard within path segment), ** (wildcard across path segments). When a source path is changed in a diff, every matching rule's derives are marked stale. The `why:` field on each rule explains the edge to future readers. The `confidence:` field signals whether stale-status is certain (high) or possible (low) — operator decides whether to act.

rules.why: The script is the single source of truth for narration text, visual tags, DIR/PACE annotations, and the asset summary. Every downstream artifact that quotes, parses, or times against it is stale when it changes.
Versioned script drafts — same downstream consequences as canonical, but only the latest version's outputs are tracked.

derives.regen: (promote latest versioned draft to canonical when audit passes)

rules.why: Re-recorded or edited narration shifts every sync-point timestamp. Precise-mode manifest must regenerate; alignment diff and audio QA become stale.
The assembly manifest is what render-episode.mjs reads to compose the final video. Any edit to it invalidates the rendered MP4.
Template data files (excluding assembly-manifest) — when edited, the corresponding template render is stale, and the manifest may need to update segment metadata.
Brand palette is the canonical color source. Changes cascade to LUTs (treat_video.py reads it), all Remotion components (theme.ts reads it), and therefore every rendered episode.

derives.regen: (re-render every episode that uses the affected colors)

rules.why: The concept registry. Changes may invalidate cross-episode callback markers and visual-spec's reuse-check output. Semantic dependency — operator decides whether re-audit is warranted.

derives.regen: (audit scripts for stale concept references via python tools/concepts/lookup.py validate)

rules.why: Template component source. Edits invalidate every render that used that template.

derives.regen: (re-render every episode that uses the affected template)

rules.why: Shared components — even more cascading impact than templates. Edits to EditorialFrame/FilmOverlay/etc. invalidate everything that imports them.
Pipeline state changes drive the At-a-glance table refresh and per-episode dashboards.
Audio cue sheet specifies SFX hits + music bed transitions per beat. When edited, the assembly manifest needs regen to thread the cues through.
Visual spec drives per-template JSON generation. When edited, those JSON files need regeneration via the visual-spec skill.
Shot list drives asset sourcing. When edited, the asset-source pipeline + zerohit-fallback briefs may be stale.
Manifest config tunes generate_manifest.py's per-episode behavior (override segments, music bed cues, fixed durations). Edits invalidate the assembly manifest.
Shorts manifest drives the 9:16 short renders.
Thumbnail spec drives the per-concept thumbnail image generator.
